gaps.note: False as stated. The formula just given is <t_T,t_S>=|T cap S|-1, which is zero only when |T cap S|=1, i.e. for neighbors. Distinct triples meeting in 0 or 2 elements give -1 or 1. The paper (lines 864-870) says neighboring triple lines are orthogonal. The later 'since t_T perp t_S' also needs T,S neighbors.
Inequality reversed. L/N=100/539 gives 2L/N=200/539<1, so 2L<N, not 2L>N. s=WD-N+2L<WD holds exactly because 2L<N; 2L>N would give s>WD. The paper has L<N/2 (line 895) and deficit N-2L>0 (line 1167).

gaps.quote: A label $U$ is a nondegenerate subspace of $\mathcal F$.
gaps.note: Nondegenerate subspace of a space with a bilinear form is not defined or linked, and is beyond dot products and orthogonality as taught. The page also gives a form only on Q^h and never says F carries the tensor-product form or that it is nondegenerate, yet needs it for U^perp, P_U and the decomposition U plus U^perp.

gaps.quote: Each unit of rank costs one smaller call. (cited)
gaps.note: The cited claim is the bridge from matrix rank to recursive calls, which is the point of the construction, but the page does not say why a rank-r edge change needs r smaller calls (the paper does this via a shear and address interchange, around lines 1130-1136). The reader cannot check why rank is the cost.

gaps.quote: The first edge out of each source has matrix $2P_{U_\iota}$, rank one, with no label change
gaps.note: The page never says the first gate on the source of index iota has label exactly U_iota (stage 1, where the earlier tensor factor space B is 0), nor that an edge matrix is head matrix minus tail matrix. Only then is it P_U-(-P_U)=2P_U. The paper gives this at lines 1162-1166. The reader cannot derive the extra N.

gaps.quote: Sources have dimension $1$, summing to $N$; sinks have dimension $D$, except the $N$ sinks that receive the sources
gaps.note: The page never states the prescribed source and sink labels: X-sources U_iota, all other sources 0, X and scratch sinks F, Y sinks U_iota^perp. 'Sources have dimension 1' is true only for the N X-sources. The telescoping claim 'gate labels cancel' also rests on gate labels that are never given (paper lines 881-889, 975-988).
